# TPC-DS-OBT Q24

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ssales AS (
  SELECT
    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
    obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
    obt.store_s_store_name,
    obt.bill_addr_ca_state,
    obt.store_s_state,
    obt.item_i_color,
    obt.item_i_current_price,
    obt.item_i_manager_id,
    obt.item_i_units,
    obt.item_i_size,
    SUM(net_paid) AS netpaid
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id
      AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk
      AND obt.ship_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk
      AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
      AND obt.bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk = obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk
      AND obt.bill_customer_c_birth_country <> UPPER(obt.bill_addr_ca_country)
      AND obt.store_s_zip = obt.bill_addr_ca_zip
      AND obt.store_s_market_id = 5
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
    obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
    obt.store_s_store_name,
    obt.bill_addr_ca_state,
    obt.store_s_state,
    obt.item_i_color,
    obt.item_i_current_price,
    obt.item_i_manager_id,
    obt.item_i_units,
    obt.item_i_size
)
SELECT
  bill_customer_c_last_name,
  bill_customer_c_first_name,
  store_s_store_name,
  SUM(netpaid) AS paid
FROM ssales
WHERE
  item_i_color = '1'
GROUP BY
  bill_customer_c_last_name,
  bill_customer_c_first_name,
  store_s_store_name
HAVING
  SUM(netpaid) > (
    SELECT
      0.05 * AVG(netpaid)
    FROM ssales
  )
ORDER BY
  bill_customer_c_last_name,
  bill_customer_c_first_name,
  store_s_store_name
```
